caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright candlestick holder positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The candlestick holder is composed of a series of rounded and baluster-shaped segments stacked vertically, creating a symmetrical and ornate form. The base is broad and circular with three distinct, tiered rings leading up to a narrower, intricately turned stem. Above the stem, the candlestick expands and contracts through several bulbous and disc-like forms before finishing at the top with a socket-like holder, which contains a short, cylindrical, brown candle stub. The entire object appears to be rendered in shades of brown, tan, and golden yellow, giving the impression of a wooden or possibly brass material. There are subtle highlights and shading that suggest the object's three-dimensional structure and smooth, polished surface.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
